subject: Renewal + Capacity Top-up: billing contact and PO hand-off
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@blueforge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + top-up — PO process and billing contact

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the renewal estimate you sent earlier. BlueForge is ready to move forward with the 24-month renewal and add the 2x GPU capacity top-up we discussed for Q1 usage growth. Before we finalize, two asks from our finance team:

- We need confirmation of the billing contact and the payor entity for the new invoice (we may split the PO between BlueForge Inc. and BlueForge EU).
- Please confirm your preferred PO routing (email to AP, portal upload, or vendor portal) and whether Redwood requires a signed W-9 (we're in the US).

Our procurement lead is copied here (accounts-payable@blueforge.com). If you can share the pro-forma invoice and the exact legal entity name to list on the PO, we'll issue the PO by next Monday.

Thanks — happy to do a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Procurement | BlueForge

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@blueforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + top-up — PO process and billing contact

Hi Samira —

Great to hear — excited to lock this in. Summary / answers below:

1) Legal entity to put on PO: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Billing address: 1400 Market St, Suite 500, San Francisco, CA 94102
2) We can accept POs by email (billing@redwood.com) or via our vendor portal (preferred for split invoices). If you need a portal invite, Marissa will set that up.
3) W-9: yes, Redwood requires a completed W-9 for US payors — attaching our standard W-9 for your records.
4) Terms: we can keep the 24-month term. For the 2x GPU capacity top-up, I'll note the addition on the pro-forma invoice (attached v2) and the unit pricing we quoted will be honored through the renewal effective date.

I've cc'd Ben (sales lead) and Marissa (billing ops) to handle PO routing and the portal invite. Once you confirm payor split details and which email to send the PO to, we'll mark the deal for final approval and generate the invoice.

Attachments: proforma_invoice_v2.pdf; Redwood_W9.pdf

Quick call is fine if you want to walk through the split payor details.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@blueforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + top-up — PO process and billing contact

Hi Samira — quick operational note from sales side:

Thanks for the confirmation. Two practical items to keep this moving:

- Preferred workflow for split payor: please include both legal payor names on the single PO and indicate percent or line-item allocation. If BlueForge EU is handling the top-up lines only, note that in the PO line description and include the EU VAT number.
- Net terms: Redwood standard for renewals is Net30, but for this commitment we can agree to Net45 if BlueForge needs it — please indicate "Net45" on the PO.
- Deliver to: billing@redwood.com and CC accounts-payable@blueforge.com so Marissa's team can reconcile.

Marissa — can you create the vendor-portal invite and confirm the invoice schedule (monthly vs. upfront for the top-up) once they send the PO and W-9?

Samira — if you want the formal DocuSign engagement packet, I can trigger it today (link below).

Link: https://docusign.com/agree/ABCD-1234

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@blueforge.com>, BlueForge Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@blueforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal + top-up — PO process and billing contact

Hi Samira / BlueForge AP team —

Thanks — we've received the PO (attached) and a signed W-9 from your team. Quick confirmation of next steps from Billing Ops:

- Attachments received: BlueForge_PO_98765.pdf; BlueForge_W9_signed.pdf
- Redwood W-9 (for vendor records) attached: Redwood_W9.pdf
- Billing contact updated to: accounts-payable@blueforge.com (we'll route future invoices there).
- Invoice schedule: We will issue the renewal invoice for the 24-month commitment on 2028-01-01. The 2x GPU capacity top-up will be invoiced as a one-time charge on the same date unless you request monthly proration — let us know.
- Net terms: PO indicates Net45 which we've accepted. Please confirm you want the top-up to be billed to BlueForge EU (line items 4-5) and provide the EU billing entity VAT and billing code for reconciliation.

Portal invite: I've generated the vendor portal account for BlueForge (invite sent to accounts-payable@blueforge.com). If you prefer email delivery of the invoice PDF, confirm and we'll send both portal and email copies.

Thanks — we'll hold final invoice issuance until you confirm the split payor allocation and provide the VAT number for BlueForge EU.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: BlueForge_PO_98765.pdf; BlueForge_W9_signed.pdf; Redwood_W9.pdf
